text.arabic_uthmani: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the first denied imperfect predicate and preparing the repeated neither-nor frame
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes denial the ayah's first operation. It governs only the first imperfect at this point, so the food's bodily effect is blocked before the wider failure of relief is named. The particle is declarative, not prohibitive: the line reports that the named food cannot nourish, rather than commanding anyone not to nourish. Because a second negator follows, this first one also starts a two-beat frame in which each expected food function receives its own denial. Its doubled onset gives the opening refusal audible weight, and the shift from the prior food naming into this verbal-effect negation turns mere availability into functional deprivation.

topics.headline: first predicate denied as fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by blocking a concrete food effect before explaining the larger hunger failure.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as the local negator of the following imperfect predicate, not as a command particle.

topics.headline: first beat of twofold denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first denial as the start of a structured effects-test, not as one broad negative statement.
topics.reason: The second negated predicate is coordinated later in the ayah, so the first particle both negates locally and prepares the repeated frame.

topics.headline: weighted refusal after food naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening refusal is felt as a hard turn from named food to denied function.
topics.reason: The particle has its own surface position at the start of the ayah, immediately after the prior food phrase supplied the subject under evaluation.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causative for producing fatness or bodily reserve, here denied and left without an expressed beneficiary object
words.root_gloss_range: fatness, bodily fullness, edible fat or clarified butter, and several unrelated lexical branches; local grammar selects caused bodily reserve and blocks the unrelated branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the opening negator governing this verb
the second matched Form IV imperfect in the paired effects-test

words.prose: {{ar:يُسْمِنُ}} ({{tr:yusminu}}) is the first tested food effect: can the prior food produce bodily reserve? The Form IV imperfect keeps that as an active causal capacity, and {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) denies the capacity rather than describing a completed failure. Its subject is carried from the prior food phrase in 88:6 without forcing which live masculine singular term is resumed, so the focus stays on effect rather than identity. No beneficiary object is spoken, so the denial is not limited to one named eater; anyone looking to this food for nourishment is left outside its benefit. The root field gives the test a bodily texture: fatness, flesh-fullness, and stored surplus stand behind the verb, while local Form IV and negation keep intensive, reflexive, edible-fat, and unrelated branches from becoming separate meanings here. The rare verbal use stands out beside the fat-cow abundance imagery (12:43): the abundance field remains, but here intake cannot produce it. Its place before {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}) makes the sequence begin with the most concrete food function before widening to sufficiency, and the paired imperfect cadence lets the smooth expectation of nourishment be heard even as it is blocked.

topics.headline: objectless causative nourishment denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the food is denied the power to cause bodily increase for any implied eater, not merely in one named case.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV imperfect active with no overt object, and the local frame records an absolute objectless causative use under negation.

topics.headline: subject carried from prior food phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps 88:7 as an evaluation of the prior named food while preserving the grammatical ambiguity of which prior masculine singular term is resumed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the subject as implicit and ambiguous between prior masculine singular food terms, so the topic survives as contextual continuation without forcing one antecedent.

topics.headline: fatness field narrowed to nutritive reserve
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denial as anti-nutritive: the thing called food cannot become stored bodily life.
topics.reason: V4 includes fatness and edible-fat branches, but the local Form IV imperfect selects caused bodily reserve; other branches remain background or are excluded locally.

topics.headline: rare verbal abundance test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the marked verbal use of a sparse fatness field, with abundance imagery inverted into failed nourishment.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact root-form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL intertext to 12:43 is a concrete abundance contrast rather than a governing parse.

topics.headline: first concrete effect before sufficiency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from bodily increase to broader need-removal in a paired causative test.
topics.reason: The first Form IV imperfect is conjoined with the second, and both sit under separately articulated negation.

topics.headline: smooth verbal cadence still blocked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the smooth first verb as part of the paired cadence while its expected nourishment is still refused.
topics.reason: The surface shape and its coordination with the matching second imperfect support a restrained sound-level observation.

words.gloss_range: conjunction segment coordinating the second negated predicate with the first and making the second failure cumulative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second negator following the conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that prevents the second clause from being only a gloss on the first. It coordinates a second failed effect with the same implicit subject: no bodily gain, and then no release from hunger. In the negative frame it functions like 'nor' while still carrying ordinary addition, so the ayah accumulates failures rather than repeating one idea. Since the conjunction is segmented before the next {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), the listener can see coordination and renewed negation as separate mechanisms even though recitation binds them tightly. The exception named in 88:6 therefore does not become relief; the particle carries it straight into another functional denial.

topics.headline: second failure added, not folded in
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sufficiency is added as a distinct failed food function rather than treated as a paraphrase of fattening.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly joins the second predicate to the first through coordination.

topics.headline: separate particle, tight recited bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the grammar split into conjunction plus renewed negation while hearing the transition as one tight movement.
topics.reason: The bundle gives the conjunction its own word slot before the second negator, supporting the distinction between syntactic segmentation and recited flow.

topics.headline: available food becomes nonfunctional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the prior exception from sounding like relief because the conjunction carries that food into another denial of function.
topics.reason: The second predicate remains coordinated with the first effect-test of the food supplied by the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: second negative particle independently negating the sufficiency predicate in the coordinated frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the conjunction immediately before this second negator

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the second predicate its own denial. Relief from hunger is not left as an implication of failed fattening; it is asserted as a separate failure with equal grammatical weight. The analytical split from {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps coordination and negation visible as two steps: the line adds another test, then blocks it. The repeated short particle also creates the ayah's clipped rhythm, turning denial into a small refrain and stopping each expected benefit before the final hunger noun arrives.

topics.headline: sufficiency receives its own denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees relief from hunger denied directly, not merely inferred from the denial of nourishment.
topics.reason: The second negative particle opens the coordinated predicate headed by the sufficiency verb and its hunger-domain phrase.

topics.headline: balanced repeated denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two food functions rejected with balanced force rather than ranked as primary and secondary.
topics.reason: The repeated negator mirrors the first particle in the local parallel structure.

topics.headline: short stops before hunger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the repeated particles as clipped stops that delay and intensify the final need-word.
topics.reason: The sequence of short particles precedes the final prepositional phrase and supports a local cadence observation.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causative for availing, sufficing, or making need unnecessary, here denied with a following hunger-domain phrase
words.root_gloss_range: wealth, self-sufficiency, availing, replacing, song, dwelling, and other branches; local Form IV plus the following phrase narrows the active sense to hunger-specific sufficing or availing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the independent negator governing this second predicate
the prepositional hunger-domain phrase completing the second denial

words.prose: {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}) widens the test from bodily reserve to sufficiency. It has its own {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), so the food is not merely unfattening; it also cannot avail at the point where food should end need. Like the first verb, it carries the prior food forward as the implicit subject, while the local frame leaves the beneficiary object unspoken and makes the following phrase the visible domain of failure. The verb is Form IV and causative: it asks whether the food can make another free of need, not whether the eater imagines independence. The root field can move through wealth, self-sufficiency, availing, song, and dwelling, but {{ar:مِن جُوعٍۢ}} ({{tr:min jūʿin}}) pulls it into practical relief from bodily dependence. In that wider pattern, wealth's avail fails (69:28) and imagined self-sufficiency is exposed (96:7), but this local clause keeps the failed resource as food and the need as hunger. Because the hunger domain is delayed until after the verb, the listener first hears the possibility of rescue and only then learns the exact need it fails to answer, with the heavier guttural opening matching the move from body mass to deeper need-removal.

topics.headline: second causative effect tested separately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sufficing is a second explicit food-function test, not a loose explanation of failed nourishment.
topics.reason: The verb is a coordinated Form IV imperfect under its own negative particle, matching the first verb's finite shape while adding a broader effect.

topics.headline: beneficiary omitted, hunger domain visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the eater mentally while the ayah keeps hunger, not the sufferer, as the pronounced complement.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence records no direct object and a following prepositional complement, with the exact form commonly appearing under negation and with prepositions.

topics.headline: broad sufficiency field narrowed to hunger relief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the broad force of being freed from need while seeing that the local issue is bodily hunger, not wealth or abstract independence.
topics.reason: V4 shows several accepted branches, but the local Form IV and following hunger phrase select availing or sufficing with respect to hunger.

topics.headline: failed resources across concrete parallels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a wider Quranic pattern of failed sufficiency while keeping the local resource and need concrete.
topics.reason: The cited rows give concrete references, but local grammar keeps them as parallels or contrasts rather than controlling the parse.

topics.headline: failed rescue before named hunger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the ayah's escalation: failed nourishment becomes failed rescue before the final deficit is disclosed.
topics.reason: The verb precedes the prepositional hunger phrase and follows the first denied causative effect.

topics.headline: heavier second verb texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second predicate as texturally heavier while the semantic test deepens from body mass to need-removal.
topics.reason: The sound observation is supported as a local surface contrast with the preceding matched imperfect.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the final hunger noun and marking the respect or separation domain in which availing fails

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sufficiency verb that this preposition complements

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes hunger the domain from which availing would release and the respect in which the food fails. It attaches to {{ar:يُغْنِى}} ({{tr:yughni}}), not back to the first predicate, so the ayah keeps the two-part structure intact: first no bodily reserve, then no sufficiency from hunger. The preposition also delays the precise deficit until the close of the verse, turning a general-looking denial of availing into a targeted failure against bodily need. Its recurrence after the earlier source-language of the food shifts the register from what the food is from to what it cannot relieve from, and its m-n sound links the first denied bodily effect to the compressed arrival of the final hunger domain.

topics.headline: hunger as release-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hunger is not a direct object but the state or respect from which relief should come and does not.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the final noun as a complement to the sufficiency verb.

topics.headline: phrase belongs to the second denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the final phrase from retroactively flattening both verbs into one hunger-governed construction.
topics.reason: The local attachment table connects the prepositional phrase to the second verb while the first and second verbs are coordinated.

topics.headline: late phrase shifts from existence to efficacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verse close by revealing that the available thing fails precisely as relief from need.
topics.reason: The preposition appears after the second verb and before the final noun, making it a compact boundary into the closing deficit phrase.

topics.headline: small preposition compressed into final noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short preposition carry the earlier verbal sound into the long final hunger word.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows make a local sound claim tied to adjacent words and the final phrase, with no contradiction from grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive verbal noun naming hunger as the final domain and unresolved deficit of the clause
words.root_gloss_range: hunger, empty-stomach need, hunger-season, caused hunger, chosen hunger, and idiomatic lack or leanness; local noun selects the experienced deficit-state without narrating a cause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing this final hunger noun

words.prose: {{ar:جُوعٍۢ}} ({{tr:jūʿin}}) is the final deficit word that explains why both denials matter. Governed by {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), it is genitive and prepositional, not a direct object or construct complement; hunger is the state from which relief should come. Its indefiniteness makes the condition open-ended rather than a single episode, and the verbal noun closes on hunger itself instead of naming a hungry person or narrating someone causing hunger. The broader root family includes being hungry, being made hungry, famine-like periods, and figurative emptiness, but the local clause concentrates that range into bodily need left unreleased. This reverses the relief formula: feeding answers hunger (106:4), but here the thing called food in 88:6 relieves nothing. Hunger therefore becomes the standard that retroactively judges both verbs, while the rare root, the prior degraded food's shared final ʿayn echo, and the long-vowel guttural close make the ayah end on unresolved need. The following shift toward ease in 88:8 is sharpened by this hard closure.

topics.headline: hunger fixed as prepositional domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hunger framed as the domain of failed relief, not as an object directly acted upon.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive after the preposition, and attachment evidence assigns it as the object of that preposition.

topics.headline: indefinite hunger as unresolved condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels hunger as a continuing bodily deficit, not a passing appetite or isolated episode.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite and the accepted V4 branch centers hunger as empty-stomach need.

topics.headline: condition named, cause and sufferer withheld
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse centers the unmet state itself instead of shifting attention to who caused it or which person is hungry.
topics.reason: V4 allows caused-hunger and hungry-person related branches, but the local surface is an abstract verbal noun in a prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: final noun gathers both failed functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hunger retroactively measure both verbs and expose the supposed food as a systematic failure.
topics.reason: The final noun arrives after the two denied food effects and is governed by the second verb's preposition.

topics.headline: relief formula inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that a familiar relief-from-hunger wording is inverted into food that leaves hunger untouched.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the concrete 106:4 parallel, while local syntax keeps 88:7 as a deprivation reversal rather than a feeding statement.

topics.headline: rare hunger root closes hard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the ayah terminate on a concentrated need-word rather than on an abstract judgment.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root-form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL sound rows tie the long-vowel and guttural closure to the final noun.

topics.headline: deprivation before ease contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the preceding food claim and following ease-scene in view as the hunger word closes one side of the passage contrast.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows explicitly link the final noun to the food claim in 88:6 and the contrastive movement into 88:8.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated negations attach separately to يُسْمِنُ and يُغْنِى, while مِن جُوعٍ names the deficit left unresolved.
baseline_models.mechanism: The substance fails two different nutritional tests: it adds no bodily reserve and it does not functionally suffice to terminate an existing deficit. The second clause is not merely a synonym of the first; a thing might fail to fatten yet still relieve hunger, but this does neither.

activation_trace.role: Bodily fatness, opposite leanness, supplies the accretion pole blocked by the first negation.
Sufficing, benefiting, or standing in supplies the functional-relief pole blocked by the second negation.
The empty stomach and its pain specify the bodily deficit that remains operative.

changed_reading.before: It is food that neither fattens nor satisfies hunger.
changed_reading.after: It fails both conversion into bodily reserve and immediate cancellation of bodily lack: intake occurs, but neither accumulation nor relief follows.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of يُسْمِنُ, يُغْنِى, and جُوعٍ each carry a non-caloric branch concerning claimed surplus, independence, and inner emptiness.
baseline_models.mechanism: An apparent increase can be socially or rhetorically inflated without producing real independence. The two negations puncture that false surplus: it cannot enlarge standing and cannot release the subject from an inward lack figured as hunger or longing.

activation_trace.role: Self-inflating claims to unowned merit or rank supply the deceptive outward increase.
Wealth and independence from need supply the genuine sufficiency that the apparent increase cannot create.
Hunger extended to emptiness or longing lets the unresolved lack exceed a merely caloric reading.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies the physical usefulness of a food.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose hollow enlargement: nothing in this intake produces real substance, independence, or an answer to inner lack.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُسْمِنُ activates a branch of restoring unequal shares, يُغْنِى names an adequate substitute, and جُوعٍ can widen from an episode to a hunger-time.
baseline_models.mechanism: Under scarcity, provision has distributive as well as bodily work: it should repair a short share or substitute adequately for what is missing. The coordinated negation allows neither function, so the item leaves both the allocation and the need uncorrected.

activation_trace.role: Equalizing partners' shares by returning excess supplies a distributive correction that the first negation can withhold.
Sufficing or standing in for something supplies the standard for an adequate replacement.
A famine-time expands the deficit from one stomach to a scarcity regime in which shares matter.

changed_reading.before: One eater remains hungry after an inadequate meal.
changed_reading.after: In a scarcity frame, the ration neither repairs a deficient share nor counts as an adequate substitute; private hunger and failed distribution coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus food becomes a failed return on exertion. Work consumes the body and conventionally yields wage or provision, but here the exhausted worker receives an intake that restores neither mass nor satiety; the later contrasting group is satisfied with its striving, showing a successful work-to-outcome circuit.

activation_trace.role: Fattening supplies the bodily restoration that exhausted labor fails to receive.
Sufficing and benefiting supply the expected utility of a worker's provision.
Empty-stomach pain is the metabolic debt left after exertion and intake.
Work's wage or worker's provision supplies the exchange link between exertion and the food that should repay it.
Exhaustion that wears a person down supplies the bodily cost requiring replenishment.
Work and earnings supply the contrasting circuit in which striving has an intelligible yield.
Satisfaction rather than displeasure marks the successful outcome missing from the exhausted group's circuit.

structural_cues: Working and exhaustion at 88:3 lead into the failed food at 88:6-7, while the reversed face-group at 88:8-9 is satisfied with its striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, exhaustion, a wage/provision branch, later earnings, and satisfaction; I supply the arrow that treats the intervening food as labor's failed return. A live alternative is purely physiological depletion with no wage relation.

changed_reading.before: The food has low nutritional value.
changed_reading.after: It is the unusable return on exhausting work: the body pays the cost, but the ration neither rebuilds the worker nor clears the hunger-debt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rare cooling branch of س م ن becomes live after a fire-and-drink sequence. In that thermal field, the first negation can deny cooling relief while the second still denies nutritional relief, making the substance fail against two simultaneous bodily stresses.

activation_trace.role: The exceptional sense of cooling supplies the surprising counterfunction blocked by لا يُسْمِنُ.
Availing or benefiting keeps the second denial as a broad failure of relief.
Hunger supplies the concurrent deficit that remains after thermal relief also fails.
Meeting fire and its heat establishes direct thermal exposure immediately before the focus.
Heat and heating intensify the condition for which cooling would be a relevant function.
Giving drink supplies the expected relief-channel, which the sequence renders hostile rather than restorative.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from heated fire at 88:4 to administered drink at 88:5 and then to exclusive food and its failed effects at 88:6-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, heat, drinking, and an exceptional cooling branch under the focus root; I infer that the sequence activates cooling as an expected countermeasure. The materially live alternative is that يُسْمِنُ remains only 'fatten' and the heat merely frames punishment.

changed_reading.before: The ration does not fatten and does not remove hunger.
changed_reading.after: Within the heat sequence it may also fail to cool: neither thermal stress nor hunger finds an effective countermeasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named food is not merely nutrient-poor; its root field stages an inversion. Food carries an image of animal fat, while ضريع carries coexisting images of plant, udder-milk, and emaciation. Expected nourishment is lexically present but its outcome is reversed into leanness, explaining why intake produces neither reserve nor relief.

activation_trace.role: Fatness opposite leanness supplies the expected somatic result explicitly denied.
Sufficing and benefiting supply the food-function that the inversion defeats.
The empty stomach supplies the persistent endpoint despite the presence of something called food.
Animal fat and the taste of grease make the label 'food' carry precisely the fattening expectation denied next.
Udder and milk supply a latent image of nourishment inside the name of the exclusive food.
Weakness and emaciation reverse the udder-milk expectation and converge on the negated fattening.
The named plant keeps the activation anchored to the immediate substance rather than replacing it with the remote root images.

structural_cues: The exclusive construction at 88:6 makes one substance occupy the food slot, and 88:7 immediately tests that substance by bodily outcome.
The repeated مِن across drink, food-source, and hunger links administered inputs to the deficits they fail to repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the food label, fat-taste, plant, udder-milk, and emaciation branches; I infer an expectation-reversal from latent nourishment to actual wasting. The immediate denotation can remain only the plant, with milk and emaciation functioning as root echoes rather than lexical substitutions.

changed_reading.before: The only available plant happens to be unsatisfying.
changed_reading.after: This is anti-nourishment: a substance occupying the food slot and carrying latent fat-and-milk expectations converts intake into neither body nor relief, while its own root field yields emaciation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposite scene supplies a complete provision cycle: good condition is visible, giving continues, and vessels enable drinking. Against that cycle, 88:7 is not only a statement about one food's composition but the bottleneck of an interrupted regime in which intake never becomes durable well-being.

activation_trace.role: Bodily increase supplies the missing conversion from provision into durable condition.
Sufficing and benefiting supply the failed endpoint of the hostile provision regime.
Hunger is the unresolved demand that distinguishes mere availability from successful provision.
Good condition and beneficence supply the visible outcome of a successful provision cycle.
Continuous provision and giving turn the running source into a sustained, rather than one-off, supply mechanism.
Drinking from a cup supplies the usable delivery endpoint present in the contrasting scene.

structural_cues: A new face-group begins at 88:8 immediately after the failed food, followed by a running source and ready cups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies good condition, continuous giving, and drinking vessels; I infer a causal supply cycle and read 88:7 as its negative counterpart. A live alternative is that these are independent scene-markers rather than causes of bodily state.

changed_reading.before: A single ration fails a single eater.
changed_reading.after: The ration belongs to an interrupted provision regime: supply is present at the mouth but cannot flow onward into bodily reserve, sufficiency, or settled well-being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The observational sequence activates a body-making analogy. Camel care and making do without water, complete proportioned formation, and mountain-like thickness all display robust form or stored capacity; the focus substance does the reverse, entering a body without generating reserve, resilience, or relief.

activation_trace.role: Fattening supplies the conversion of intake into embodied reserve that fails in the focus.
Sufficing supplies resilience against need, the functional result absent alongside bodily reserve.
Empty-stomach hunger supplies the scarcity pressure under which reserve should matter.
Camels and their care supply a concrete animal body against which nourishment and reserve can be imagined.
Making do without water supplies a model of embodied capacity enduring scarcity.
Complete, proportioned formation supplies the successful body-making outcome opposed to wasting.
Thickness of bodily form lets mountain mass reinforce the image of substantial embodiment.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف cue repeats at 88:17-20, directing attention to how camel, sky, mountains, and earth have been made or configured.
The same ن ص ب root that marks bodily exhaustion at 88:3 marks mountains set upright at 88:19, juxtaposing depleted and stable forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies camel care, water-sparing capacity, proportioned creation, thick bodily form, and repeated how-questioning; I supply the organismal arrow from intake to reserve. A live alternative is that the created objects invite observation without commenting on metabolism.

changed_reading.before: The food does not increase body weight.
changed_reading.after: It fails as body-making material: unlike forms configured for solidity and endurance, this intake cannot become reserve or confer resilience against scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later punishment root carries abstention, withholding, and pain together. It changes the focus from accidental dietary inadequacy into a possible technique of sustained deprivation: something is administered as food, yet nourishment and release are withheld so that need itself persists as part of the pain.

activation_trace.role: Blocked bodily increase supplies the nourishment deliberately absent from the administered substance.
Blocked benefit or sufficiency supplies the withheld release from the condition.
Persistent empty-stomach pain becomes part of the punitive mechanism rather than a side effect.
The body's abstention from food and drink supplies deprivation as a bodily state.
Withholding, prevention, or weaning supplies the active non-transfer of nourishment.
Pain and punishment supply the governing function into which sustained hunger can be recruited.

structural_cues: The food and drink failures at 88:4-7 occur inside the same sequence that later names punishment explicitly at 88:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abstention, withholding, pain, and the focus's two failed food-functions; I infer the arrow that makes continued deficit instrumental to punishment. The live alternative is an inert bad food whose effects are punitive without being calibrated to preserve hunger.

changed_reading.before: The substance is accidentally or intrinsically non-nutritive.
changed_reading.after: Its non-nutrition may be the operative punishment: intake is allowed, but transfer into body and relief is withheld so hunger continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return followed by accounting reactivates the focus branch of equalizing partners' shares. The bad ration supplies no balancing credit and no adequate offset against scarcity; the final sequence relocates settlement to a later return and reckoning, where sufficiency and accounting occupy the same root field.

activation_trace.role: Returning excess to equalize unequal shares supplies the settlement model denied to the ration.
Sufficing or replacing supplies the criterion for whether the ration can count as an offset.
Famine-time supplies the scarcity ledger in which deficient shares and adequate offsets matter.
Return to the destination supplies the temporal reopening of an unsettled account.
Counting and accounting supply the explicit settlement procedure.
Sufficiency and enrichment bridge the final account back to the denied يُغْنِى function.

structural_cues: The surah closes with ordered return at 88:25 and then accounting at 88:26, after the focus has twice denied that the ration settles its deficit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies share-equalization, return, accounting, and a second sufficiency branch; I infer a ledger in which the ration is a failed provisional credit and final reckoning performs settlement. A live alternative is that bodily hunger and final accounting remain only analogically parallel.

changed_reading.before: The ration cannot compensate for one episode of hunger.
changed_reading.after: It enters no balancing credit against the deficit; return and final accounting, not the ration, become the locus where unequal shares and claims are settled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface form يُغْنِى strongly favors causative sufficing, whereas song normally takes another derivation. It remains anchored in the packet's song branch for the same root and is independently activated by the later hearing/song and mixed-noise branches. Render it only as a sonic undertone or root echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to يُغْنِى and lets جُوعٍ retain its branch of longing or emptiness.

activation_trace.role: Song and vocal modulation supply a latent acoustic value under the focus root.
Hunger as longing supplies an affective lack to which voice or song might otherwise answer.
Pleasurable hearing and song activate the acoustic branch without erasing the focus form.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the rejected acoustic counterfield in the contrasting scene.

changed_reading.before: It does not suffice against hunger.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, it also gives no sustaining voice or song to answer hunger-as-longing; the later good scene excludes both song-like audition and noise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The decorative-pigment branch is nominal and remote from the focus verb, so this cannot govern its ordinary sense. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because the later scene repeatedly places, aligns, and spreads visible furnishings while the focus denies internal sufficiency. Downstream prose should mark it as a surface-versus-substance echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reading attaches to the decorative-pigment branch of س م ن at يُسْمِنُ and to the explicit failure of يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ.

activation_trace.role: Decorative pigments supply a surface treatment that cannot become bodily substance.
Failure to suffice prevents cosmetic surface from counting as functional nourishment.
Emptiness beneath appearance supplies the interior deficit left untouched by decoration.
Putting each object in a settled place begins the contrasting scene's deliberate surface arrangement.
Alignment on an even line supplies ordered visual presentation.
Spreading things out completes the furnishing field that activates decoration as a contrast.

changed_reading.before: The food cannot build the body or relieve hunger.
changed_reading.after: At the material-surface edge of the root, it cannot even furnish or color a convincing exterior; arranged appearance and internal sufficiency remain radically separate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This circuit is surprising because it joins remote branch images from a plant-name, raised couches, and camels. It remains anchored in the focus's fattening and hunger tests, while udder-milk and retained milk provide a traceable non-transfer mechanism. Render it as a pastoral latent network, not as the direct denotation of مرفوعة or ضريع.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The circuit returns to لا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ as a failed transfer of animal nourishment into bodily reserve and satiety.

activation_trace.role: Fattening supplies the bodily outcome that successful milk transfer would ordinarily support.
Sufficing supplies the functional endpoint absent when nourishment does not transfer.
Persistent hunger supplies evidence that the latent nourishment never reaches the eater.
Udder and milk place potential animal nourishment inside the root field of the exclusive food.
Weakness and emaciation show the bodily result when that nourishment fails to transfer.
Milk retained in the udder supplies the hidden valve that blocks transfer, though the source surface immediately describes raised couches.
Camels and their care complete the pastoral body-and-milk environment of the latent circuit.

changed_reading.after: A pastoral root network stages nourishment as present but retained: udder and milk appear, transfer closes, emaciation follows, and the eater gains neither reserve nor relief.

strongest_changes: The dual negation separates failed body-building from failed relief, then the labor context recasts both as an unpaid metabolic debt.
The ضريع and طعام inventories turn dietary inadequacy into an inversion in which latent fat and milk terminate in emaciation.
Fire, heat, and administered drink awaken the rare cooling branch of س م ن, preserving a thermal reading alongside literal fattening.
The punishment inventory makes continued hunger plausibly instrumental withholding rather than an accidental consequence.
Return and accounting strengthen a coexisting scarcity-ledger reading in which the ration supplies no balancing credit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports simultaneous metabolic, labor-economic, thermal, distributive, punitive, and body-making mechanisms. Its richest activation is the contradiction inside the food field itself: fat-taste and udder-milk are available as latent expectations, yet emaciation, non-transfer, and hunger are the realized outputs. Acoustic, decorative, and pastoral readings remain live as contained root echoes rather than being normalized away.
remaining_uncertainties: Cooling, song, pigment, and retained-milk activations are branch-backed but form- or domain-distant, so none should replace the ordinary verbal readings.
The arrows from labor to ration, from provision to bodily state, and from final accounting to share settlement are reader-supplied causal or analogical moves.
The famine and allocation model widens singular bodily hunger into a social scarcity regime; both scales should remain available.
The context does not force a choice between inert inadequacy and deliberately punitive withholding.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Double negation of nourishment and sufficiency.** Evidence: `س م ن` B001 fatness; `غ ن ي` B002 sufficing/availing, B001 self-sufficiency; `ج و ع` B001 empty stomach. Structural cue: two coordinated negations follow the defective food of 88:6. Role: fatness is bodily surplus; ghina is functional sufficiency; hunger is the deficit that remains. Abductive move: true food must change both body-state and need-state. Reading change: the ayah reads as a diagnostic test of failed provision.

2. **Economic insufficiency after labor.** Evidence: `غ ن ي` B001 wealth/self-sufficiency, B002 availing; `ع م ل` B004 wage/pay in 88:3; later `ح س ب` B001 reckoning. Structural cue: labor precedes, account follows. Role: `يغني` asks whether the result pays off or avails; it does not. Abductive move: punishment is measured partly by the collapse of exchange: work yields no sufficiency. Reading change: the ayah becomes economic as well as bodily: no profit, no covering of need.

3. **Pastoral depletion before the camel sign.** Evidence: `س م ن` B001 animal fatness; `ج و ع` B004 emptiness/leanness; later `ء ب ل` B001 camels and `خ ش ع` B004 depleted hump. Structural cue: camel bodies appear later as objects to inspect. Role: the negated fatness anticipates visible animal morphology. Abductive move: the surah teaches through bodies whose stored fat or height is legible. Reading change: the hunger line prepares the reader to see moral consequence as bodily leanness and depleted elevation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later `الإبل` made this ayah’s animal-body vocabulary unavoidable: fatness, hump, pasture, and water form one ecological chain. The positive `ناعمة` faces sharpened the contrast between a body that cannot be made full and a face living in ease.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The paired negation tests provision at two distinct scales.** **Lexical:** `س م ن` B001, bodily fatness; `غ ن ي` B002, sufficing or availing; and `ج و ع` B001, an empty stomach. **Cue:** parallel `لَا ... وَلَا` predicates move from measurable bodily gain to relief of the underlying need, both governed by the food of 88:6. **Role:** fatness is the somatic output metric, sufficiency is the functional output metric, and hunger is the unresolved input state. **Abduction:** I infer a staged evaluation rather than synonymous repetition. **Reading change:** the ayah becomes a compact failure analysis: the food produces neither stored bodily benefit nor even immediate need-resolution.

2. **Hunger expands from an empty stomach into an empty provisioning relation.** **Lexical:** `ج و ع` B004, "hunger as emptiness or leanness," and `غ ن ي` B001, self-sufficiency or wealth. **Cue:** the denial follows the exclusive plant ration of 88:6 and is then answered by ease, satisfaction, a garden, silence, and a flowing spring in 88:8-12. **Role:** the emptiness branch broadens lack beyond the belly, while the wealth branch names the absent capacity to sustain oneself. **Abduction:** I infer that the later environment exemplifies what sufficiency would require; it is not explicitly presented as a definition. **Reading change:** `من جوع` names not only a pang but a failed relation between body and world, one that the following integrated habitat reverses.

3. **Sufficiency includes the capacity to settle and remain, which this food cannot produce.** **Lexical:** `غ ن ي` B004, "settled dwelling or having been there." **Cue:** `لَا يُغْنِى` is followed within the window by `فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ`, acoustic rest, and a running spring in 88:10-12. **Role:** the dwelling branch supplies a durable spatial consequence of being sufficiently provisioned. **Abduction:** I infer that food which does not avail cannot establish inhabitable continuity, whereas the following garden can. **Reading change:** the failure is not just momentary nutrition; it is inability to support a settled life.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:8-12 unexpectedly expanded `غ ن ي` beyond immediate relief. Soft faces, satisfaction, garden, acoustic rest, and finally a running spring activated B004 settled dwelling, so the failed food was seen to block durable habitation as well as bodily satiety.

findings.text: İki olumsuzlama besini iki ayrı ölçekte sınar: Bedende yedek oluşturma ile mevcut ihtiyacı işlevsel olarak giderme birbirinden ayrılır ve ikisi de başarısız olur.
Açlığın boşluğu ile kendi kendine yetememe birleşince eksiklik yalnız midede değil, beden ile onu yaşatan çevre arasındaki ilişkide görünür.
Yeterliliğin yerleşip kalmayı da kapsaması, bu yiyeceğin anlık doygunluk yanında sürdürülebilir bir yaşam alanı kuramadığını; sonraki bahçenin ise tam bunu sağladığını gösterir.
Zenginlik ve yeterlilik çağrışımı, önceki emeğin hiçbir kazanç ya da karşılık üretmediği ekonomik bir yoksunluk da ekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, tokluğun karşıtı olan açlığı midenin yiyeceksiz kalmasından doğan bedensel rahatsızlıkla açıkça birleştirir. Bir kez yaşanan açlık ve sürekli aç görünen ya da sık sık azar azar yiyen kişi, bu çekirdeğin bağımlı adlandırmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bireyin bedensel açlık durumuyla sınırlıdır; toplu açlık zamanı, aç bırakma eylemi ve aktarmalı kullanımlar bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dalın yalın anlamı tanımlanır; türemiş kişi ve tek sefer adları çekirdeğe bağlı kalır, başka dallardaki söz öbeği anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Midenin yiyeceksiz kalmasıyla canlıda rahatsızlık ya da ağrı doğuran ve tokluğun karşısında yer alan bedensel durumdur. Bunun tek seferlik yaşanması ile sürekli aç görünen ya da sık aralıklarla azar azar yiyen kişinin adlandırılması çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Tokluğun karşıtı olan ve midenin yiyeceksiz kalmasıyla canlıda rahatsızlık ya da ağrı doğuran bedensel durumdur.
Bu durumun tek bir kez yaşanması ayrıca adlandırılabilir.
Sürekli aç görünen ya da sık aralıklarla azar azar yiyen kişi için türemiş bir ad kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar açlığı tokluğun karşıtı ve yiyeceksiz midenin canlıda doğurduğu bedensel sıkıntı olarak ortaklaştırır; ayrıca tek seferlik açlığı ve açlığı sürekli görünen kişinin adını kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir boşluk ve incelik anlamı vermez; belirli yapılarda buluşmaya güçlü özlem, kabın dolu olmaması ve kadının karnının ince olması şeklinde üç ayrı aktarım sunar. Dal korunur, ancak yalın bir anlam gibi değil, yapıya göre değişen kullanımlar kümesi olarak tanımlanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu üç aktarım yalnız kendi yapılarında geçerlidir; bedensel açlığın yalın anlamına veya birbirlerinin bağlamlarına genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal bütünüyle belirli söz yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; özlem, dolu olmayan kap ve ince karın anlamları yalın kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapılarında açlık görüntüsünü buluşmaya duyulan güçlü özleme, bir kabın dolu olmamasına veya bir kadının karnının ince oluşuna aktaran kullanımlar kümesidir. Her anlam yalnız kendisini kuran yapı içinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Açlık görüntüsü yalnız belirli söz yapıları içinde, yapının belirlediği aktarmalı bir anlama taşınır.
Bir kabın aç diye nitelenmesi, kabın dolu olmadığını bildirir.
Bir kadının kuşağının aç diye nitelenmesi, kadının karnının ince olduğunu bildirir.
Buluşmaya yönelik açlık anlatımı, o buluşmaya duyulan güçlü özlemi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, yalın bir anlamdan çok, açlık görüntüsünü farklı sonuçlara taşıyan ve anlamı kullanılan yapıya göre belirlenen bir aktarım kümesidir.
